evidence_summary: Replay log shows two independent cycles (REQ 5 and REQ 10) of POST /v2/vectordb/entities/search with groupParams.groupByField="vector" (groupSize=1) both returning http=200 code=0 with 5 identical-distance ungrouped hits, i.e. the illegal vector-field group_by is silently accepted and the grouping semantics silently dropped.
rationale: Same-version explicit contract milvus_state_group_by_field_001 (grouping-search.md) requires group_by_field to be a scalar non-vector field, and the capture contains a twice-reproduced clear contract violation (illegal op accepted with 200/code=0), which via semantic matching of the replay HTTP evidence satisfies the high-evidence Type1 illegal-success path (1+ successful reproduction + clear contract violation).
